conditions.runtime: logical server and client both load MapSyncer 1.0.4 beta2 with Xaero World Map 1.46.0

change.summary: Use MapSyncer as the single owner that converts server-generated MCA regions and synchronizes missing or newer terrain into each client's native Xaero World Map

before.value: MapSyncer 1.0.3 conversion plus Unified Xaero Worldmap 2.0.1 player-tile sharing

after.value: MapSyncer 1.0.4 beta2 only, with Xaero World Map as its required functional dependency
TICK every 6000 server ticks, comparing MCA timestamps and generated-region hashes so unchanged regions are skipped

before.value: Terrain sharing owner was ambiguous between two addons

after.value: Terrain only is shared; personal waypoints, homes, bases, labels, colors, groups, settings and death points remain private

rationale.purpose: Make all server-generated and player-explored terrain available to every client without continuous full-map scanning or duplicate synchronization stores.
rationale.decision_source: Direct user request on 2026-11-01 plus the user-supplied MapSyncer and Unified Xaero Worldmap repositories; exact installed logs proved MapSyncer 1.0.3 failed with NoSuchFieldException: AIR and configuration proved incremental updates were disabled.

introduced.summary: Replace MapSyncer 1.0.3 and Unified Xaero Worldmap 2.0.1 with official MapSyncer 1.0.4 beta2 and a five-minute incremental server policy.

history.summary: Selected official MapSyncer 1.0.4 beta2 as the single terrain sync owner and removed Unified Xaero Worldmap from the intended client and server inventories.

relations: server MCA region -> MapSyncer conversion cache -> timestamp/hash delta -> native client Xaero region
notes: Xaero World Map remains installed on both sides and owns rendering, controls and personal map storage.

The upstream Forge metadata declares Forge and Minecraft dependencies but does not declare xaeroworldmap, so JEM enforces the functional dependency through the canonical client and server inventories.
No MineRENT, stable-profile or release-baseline change is part of this branch.
unresolved: Player acceptance remains pending because no client or gameplay launch was authorized.
